name: [Part 1] Nested intervals and stable text order
input: same endpoints, nested intervals, and a later touching chunk
test:
actual = merge_chunks([(0, 10, 'A'), (0, 10, 'B'), (2, 3, 'C'), (10, 12, 'D')], [], [])
assert actual == [{'role': 'agent', 'start': 0, 'end': 12, 'text': 'A B C D'}]

name: [Part 1] Equal-start role order without cross-role merging
[Part 2] First interior user start interrupts
test:
merged = merge_chunks([(10, 30, 'A')], [(25, 26, 'later'), (20, 21, 'first')], [(15, 18, 'T')])
actual = mark_interruptions(merged)
assert actual == [
    {'role': 'agent', 'start': 10, 'end': 20, 'text': 'A ... [INTERRUPTED]', 'interrupted': True},
    {'role': 'tool', 'start': 15, 'end': 18, 'text': 'T', 'interrupted': False},
    {'role': 'user', 'start': 20, 'end': 21, 'text': 'first', 'interrupted': False},
    {'role': 'user', 'start': 25, 'end': 26, 'text': 'later', 'interrupted': False},
]

name: [Part 2] Already speaking and endpoint ties are not interruptions
input: earlier user overlap, same start, or agent-end start

name: [Part 2] Each agent is checked independently
input: two agents interrupted by distinct user starts
test:
actual = mark_interruptions(merge_chunks([(0, 10, 'A'), (20, 30, 'B')], [(5, 6, 'U'), (25, 26, 'V')], []))
agents = [item for item in actual if item['role'] == 'agent']
assert [item['end'] for item in agents] == [5, 25]
assert all(item['interrupted'] for item in agents)

name: [Part 3] Positive adjacent gap
input: user ends at 5; next agent starts at 12
test:
marked = mark_interruptions(merge_chunks([(12, 20, 'A')], [(0, 5, 'U')], []))
assert insert_gaps(marked) == [
    {'role': 'user', 'start': 0, 'end': 5, 'text': 'U', 'interrupted': False},
    {'role': 'gap', 'start': 5, 'end': 12, 'text': '[7 ms gap]', 'interrupted': False},
    {'role': 'agent', 'start': 12, 'end': 20, 'text': 'A', 'interrupted': False},
]

name: [Part 3] No gap on touching, overlap, or opposite roles
[Part 4] Even median ignores other durations
input: gap durations 3, 8, with a long tool interval
test:
chunks = [
    {'role': 'gap', 'start': 0, 'end': 3, 'text': '[3 ms gap]', 'interrupted': False},
    {'role': 'tool', 'start': 3, 'end': 103, 'text': 'T', 'interrupted': False},
    {'role': 'gap', 'start': 103, 'end': 111, 'text': '[8 ms gap]', 'interrupted': False},
]
assert thinking_time_p50(chunks) == 5.5

name: [Part 4] Odd median and duplicate durations
test:
chunks = [dict(role='gap', start=0, end=duration, text=f'[{duration} ms gap]', interrupted=False) for duration in [9, 2, 2]]
assert thinking_time_p50(chunks) == 2

name: [All parts] Empty and singleton timelines
test:
assert mark_interruptions([]) == []
assert insert_gaps([]) == []
assert thinking_time_p50([]) == 0
marked = mark_interruptions(merge_chunks([(0, 10, 'A')], [], []))
assert marked == [{'role': 'agent', 'start': 0, 'end': 10, 'text': 'A', 'interrupted': False}]
assert insert_gaps(marked) == marked
assert thinking_time_p50(marked) == 0

name: [All parts] Pipeline example and input preservation
input: all stages preserve inputs and produce gap P50 of 5
test:
from copy import deepcopy
agent, user, tool = [(10, 20, 'Hello')], [(15, 16, 'Wait'), (0, 5, 'Hi')], []
original = deepcopy((agent, user, tool))
merged = merge_chunks(agent, user, tool)
assert (agent, user, tool) == original
before = deepcopy(merged)
marked = mark_interruptions(merged)
assert merged == before
before_marked = deepcopy(marked)
timeline = insert_gaps(marked)
assert marked == before_marked
assert [item['role'] for item in timeline] == ['user', 'gap', 'agent', 'user']
assert [item['end'] for item in timeline] == [5, 10, 15, 16]
before_timeline = deepcopy(timeline)
assert thinking_time_p50(timeline) == 5
assert timeline == before_timeline
marked[0]['text'] = 'changed'
assert merged == before
assert timeline == before_timeline
